name: WolfModelSet
meaning: High nibble of descriptor byte 2 (-> wolf+0x711).

name: WMS_RALPH
meaning: normal model (costume +0x712 may still be 4 = rabbit); the record's own model (modelSets[0]); in a state descriptor 0 selects the costume's set (Wolf::SetStateAnim)

name: WMS_EXPLOSION
meaning: modelSets[1] = g_wolfAltModelIds[0] = WAR_IDO_AEXPLOS2 (one animation, BOOM); used by state 0x0e WOLF_ST_DIE_FELL only

name: WMS_RABBITCOSTUME
meaning: Rabbit costume: Wolf_SwapHeldItem enters state 0xA0 for class 99 only when modelSet != 4, and undresses (state 0xA2) when modelSet == 4; reached through costume byte +0x712 = 4 in Wolf_SetStateAnim; modelSets[4] = g_wolfAltModelIds[3] = WAR_IDO_ACOLAP01
